fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) has risen 18.9% over three months, substantially outperforming the S&P 500, and trades near the year-to-date high by 2.5%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal year 2026 revenue growth has accelerated to 14.8% (versus 11.3% in 2025 and 10.0% in 2024), while value-added services achieved 30% growth reaching $14 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: Valuation on earnings per share stands at 34.6x, a significant premium to the S&P 500 median of 21.9x, though operating margin of 65.1% remains below historical peaks.
